## Data and sources

City Traffic Benchmarks version 4 supplies five-minute road volume and speed for Yekaterinburg. This case retains the existing 720-road register and the complete source day of 18 October 2024. The selected-day method produces 96 fifteen-minute frames.

Volume retains the declared unit `source volume`; the Parquet files do not supply a physical volume unit or timezone. Speed values are retained as supplied. A derived congestion index combines slowdown relative to full-history nonzero speed P90 with clipped log-volume weight relative to the selected-day frame-volume P95.

Read the complete prepared day used for the dataset summary and later checks.

```{r read-prepared-day}
prepared_file <- "data/input.rds"
day_input <- readRDS(prepared_file)
```

```{r source-summary, echo=FALSE}
original_sources <- read.csv("data/original-sources.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
knitr::kable(
  original_sources[c("file", "provider", "role")],
  caption = "Original data sources",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c("Roads", "Fifteen-minute frames", "Flow records", "Additional measurement records", "Trend records", "Primary unit"),
    Value = c(
      nrow(day_input[["roads"]]), length(day_input[["times"]]),
      nrow(day_input[["flow"]]), nrow(day_input[["measurements"]]),
      nrow(day_input[["trends"]]), day_input[["unit"]]
    )
  ),
  caption = "Complete prepared dataset",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
```

The road register and date are fixed source selections for this example; the conversion does not choose new roads or a different day.

## Raw input and field meanings

### Inspect the original-format teaching excerpt

The teaching excerpt reads two original Parquet road IDs—21263 and 2565—and six five-minute slots from 00:00 through 00:25. The full-history calibration remains attached to those roads.

The excerpt is part of the same 720-road, 2024-10-18 example. Its converted values are compared with the matching road and time keys in `data/input.rds`. The excerpt explains individual calculations; the map and daily curve use the complete prepared day.

The prepared interval in this example is fixed at fifteen minutes: each frame uses three consecutive five-minute source slots. The unit remains `source volume`, since a physical volume unit has not been established. The selected road file and source date define the scope checked below. The report's map-time parameter selects an existing prepared frame.

```{r read-raw}
raw_directory <- "data/raw"
selection_file <- "data/raw/selected-roads.csv"
calibration_file <- "data/raw/calibration.csv"
source_day <- "2024-10-18"
source_minutes <- seq(0, 25, 5)

native <- read_metropolis_raw(
  base = ".",
  raw_dir = raw_directory,
  selection_file = selection_file,
  day = source_day,
  minutes = source_minutes,
  calibration_file = calibration_file
)
```

```{r show-raw, echo=FALSE}
volume_rows <- data.frame(
  timestamp = native[["labels"]],
  t(native[["volume"]]), check.names = FALSE
)
speed_rows <- data.frame(
  timestamp = native[["labels"]],
  t(native[["speed"]]), check.names = FALSE
)
names(volume_rows)[-1] <- names(speed_rows)[-1] <- paste0("node_", native[["ids"]])

interval_rows <- data.frame(
  timestamp = native[["labels"]],
  setNames(volume_rows[-1], paste0("Volume ", native[["ids"]])),
  setNames(speed_rows[-1], paste0("Speed ", native[["ids"]])),
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(interval_rows, caption = "Original five-minute Parquet measurements",
             format = "html", row.names = FALSE)

field_dictionary <- data.frame(
  Source_field = c("static row position", "x/y start and end", "length", "timestamp", "node_ID volume", "node_ID speed", "history speed P90", "frame volume P95"),
  Meaning = c("Zero-based road identifier", "Directed endpoint coordinates", "Source road length", "Five-minute source clock", "Native source volume", "Native source speed", "Free-flow reference", "Volume-weight reference"),
  Standard_destination = c("road_id", "roads geometry", "retained road attribute", "fifteen-minute time", "flow", "measurements: speed", "provenance and index", "provenance and index")
)
knitr::kable(field_dictionary, caption = "Key source fields", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

Missing speed remains distinct from observed zero volume. The source adapter retains native coverage masks, contributor counts, and fill methods in provenance.

```{r native-source, echo=FALSE}
native_directory <- tempfile("native-source-")
dir.create(native_directory)
native_file <- file.path(native_directory, "source.rds")
stopifnot(!file.exists(native_file))
```

```{r native-source-2, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(native, native_file, compress = "xz", version = 3)
restored_native <- readRDS(native_file)
```

```{r native-source-3, include=FALSE}
stopifnot(identical(restored_native, native))
native <- restored_native
invisible(capture.output(str(native, max.level = 1, give.attr = FALSE)))
```

A temporary `source.rds` readback confirms that the imported source records are unchanged.

### Deliberately invalid timestamps and correction

The fifteen-minute conversion requires unique, ordered five-minute timestamps. The following in-memory copy duplicates the first timestamp and therefore breaks the exact grid; the Parquet files are unchanged.

```{r invalid-input, echo=FALSE}
bad_labels <- native$labels
bad_labels[2] <- bad_labels[1]
cat(tryCatch(
  {
    metropolis_bins(native$volume, bad_labels)
    "No error was raised."
  },
  error = conditionMessage
))
```

The corrected labels are the six unique, consecutive timestamps read from the source. Missing cells are retained in the native status mask; they are not automatically interpreted as observed zero.

```{r corrected-input-check, echo=FALSE}
corrected_bins <- metropolis_bins(native$volume, native$labels)
stopifnot(length(unique(native$labels)) == length(native$labels))
data.frame(
  roads = nrow(native$volume),
  five_minute_slots = ncol(native$volume),
  fifteen_minute_frames = length(corrected_bins$times),
  native_missing = sum(is.na(native$volume)),
  observed_zero = sum(native$volume == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

## Convert with the road plotting interface

`metropolis_input()` is an **example adapter**, not a public package API. It implements this source's fifteen-minute averaging, recorded fill rules, geometry construction, speed measurement, congestion-index calculation, and source trends. The resulting canonical tables are then passed to the road table interface.

### Prepare canonical tables

```{r prepare-canonical-tables}
adapter_output <- metropolis_input(native)

roads <- adapter_output[["roads"]]
flow <- adapter_output[["flow"]]
measurements <- adapter_output[["measurements"]]
trends <- adapter_output[["trends"]]
times <- adapter_output[["times"]]
interval_seconds <- adapter_output[["interval_seconds"]]
```

Once the canonical tables exist, the public call is the same interface used by other road datasets:

### Assemble road-map arguments

```{r construct-road_input-input}
road_input <- list(crs = "EPSG:4326",
  roads = roads,
  flow = flow,
  measurements = measurements,
  metric_info = adapter_output[["metric_info"]],
  trends = trends,
  times = times,
  interval_seconds = interval_seconds,
  unit = adapter_output[["unit"]],
  provenance = adapter_output[["provenance"]]
)
```

The result is a data-only named list. It retains roads, flow, measurements, trends, frame starts, interval widths, units and provenance; it does not contain a selected display label, title, palette or basemap.

### What does `road_input` contain?

```{r road_input-structure, include=FALSE}
str(road_input, max.level = 1, give.attr = FALSE)
```

```{r show-road_input, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  road_input[["roads"]][c("road_id", "length", "speedLimit", "freeFlowSpeed", "maxVolume")],
  caption = "Prepared roads table",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  road_input[["flow"]], caption = "Prepared fifteen-minute flow table",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  road_input[["measurements"]], caption = "Prepared speed and congestion measurements",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(
  road_input[["trends"]], caption = "Prepared supplied trends",
  format = "html", row.names = FALSE
)
```

For road 21263, volumes 3, 6, and 5 produce first-quarter flow 4.67; the corresponding mean speed is 81.88 and the derived congestion index is 0.040. The index is computed as:

```text
slowdown = clip(1 - frame_speed / history_speed_P90, 0, 1)
weight   = clip(log1p(frame_volume) / log1p(frame_volume_P95), 0, 1)
index    = slowdown * weight
```

The index is derived from supplied data and calibration; it is not a congestion label present in the raw Parquets.

The conversion changes four things while retaining the source meaning:

- **Identifier and geometry:** zero-based static Parquet row IDs become character `road_id` values with directed start/end coordinates.
- **Time:** three complete five-minute slots become one fifteen-minute frame start.
- **Measurements:** volume remains `source volume`; speed remains `source speed`; congestion is explicitly marked as a derived dimensionless index.
- **Coverage metadata:** native observed, missing, and imputed status; contributor counts; fill methods; calibration; selection; and source identities remain in provenance.

<div class="note">Road maps take <code>roads</code> and <code>flow</code> tables with their time and units. Events and additional measurements are optional road-map inputs. OD maps use separate station and trip tables.</div>

## Pass the road input to `traffic_flow_map()`

### Draw the bundled frame

In a fresh R session with this example's directory as the working directory, load the bundled package and read the supplied 08:00 single-frame RDS and pass it directly to the plotter.

```r
source("../../bdynets/inst/preparation-session.R")
preparation_session(getwd())
library(bdynets)
frame <- readRDS("data/map-frame-0800.rds")
traffic_flow_map(frame, basemap = NULL)
```

### Prepare a frame for the report

The report prepares a frame at the requested clock time from the full-day data. It uses the full day for the daily curve and passes a single prepared frame to the map.

```{r plot-prepare}
road_args <- day_input[intersect(names(day_input), names(formals(traffic_data)))]
# UTC decodes the numeric wall-clock encoding without assigning a source timezone.
road_args$time_labels <- format(as.POSIXct(road_args$times, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC"),
                                "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")
frame_index <- which(substr(road_args$time_labels, 12L, 16L) == params$time_label)
if (length(frame_index) != 1L) stop("Choose one existing map frame in HH:MM.")

frame_args <- road_args
frame_args$times <- road_args$times[frame_index]
frame_args$time_labels <- road_args$time_labels[frame_index]
frame_args$interval_seconds <- road_args$interval_seconds[frame_index]
frame_args$flow <- road_args$flow[road_args$flow$time == frame_args$times, , drop = FALSE]
frame_args$measurements <- road_args$measurements[
  road_args$measurements$time == frame_args$times, , drop = FALSE
]
frame_args$trends <- road_args$trends[road_args$trends$time == frame_args$times, , drop = FALSE]
day_view <- do.call(traffic_data, road_args)
frame_view <- do.call(traffic_data, frame_args)
map_input <- frame_view
map_input$time_labels <- NULL
map_input$time_label_format <- "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"
```

### Road volume map

```{r road-map, fig.alt="Prepared City-traffic-M volume in the selected fifteen-minute frame."}
volume_map <- traffic_flow_map(
  frame_view,
  basemap = if (params[["basemap"]])
    list(mode = "auto", cache_dir = "data/basemap-cache", offline = TRUE) else NULL,
  flow_style = list(
    breaks = c(0.982, 2.93, 6.79, 14.4, 29.6, 59.7),
    labels = c("0 to < 0.982", "0.982 to < 2.93", "2.93 to < 6.79", "6.79 to < 14.4",
               "14.4 to < 29.6", "29.6 to < 59.7", ">= 59.7"),
    palette = c("#16a43a", "#7ad151", "#f7ea2a", "#ffc928",
                "#f5a623", "#f36b2b", "#f01818"),
    right = FALSE
  ),
  title = "City-traffic-M traffic volume",
  caption = paste0("Frame ", params$time_label,
    "; prepared fifteen-minute road volume; missing values are grey.")
)
```

### Daily mean road volume

```{r road-trend, fig.height=4.4}
flow_trend <- traffic_trend(day_view)
plot(flow_trend, metric = "mean", index = frame_index)
```

The map and curve use the primary volume field. Observed zeros contribute to the mean and missing values are excluded. The curve is a mean across available roads, not a citywide vehicle total.

```{r selected-frame-check, include=FALSE}
stopifnot(
  identical(volume_map$data$times, frame_args$times),
  identical(volume_map$data$values, day_view$values[frame_index, , drop = FALSE])
)
stopifnot(
  identical(volume_map$data$metrics,
    lapply(day_view$metrics, function(values) values[frame_index, , drop = FALSE]))
)
```

## Validate the conversion

```{r road-drawing-matrix, include=FALSE}
drawing_values <- matrix(NA_real_, length(road_input$times), nrow(road_input$roads),
  dimnames = list(as.character(road_input$times), road_input$roads$road_id))
row_index <- match(road_input$flow$time, road_input$times)
column_index <- match(road_input$flow$road_id, road_input$roads$road_id)
drawing_values[cbind(row_index, column_index)] <- road_input$flow$flow
drawing_values
```

```{r drawing-matrix-readback, include=FALSE}
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(row_index), !anyNA(column_index),
  identical(as.numeric(drawing_values[cbind(row_index, column_index)]),
            as.numeric(road_input$flow$flow))
)
```

```{r validation, echo=FALSE}
flow_at <- match(
  paste(road_input[["flow"]][["road_id"]], road_input[["flow"]][["time"]]),
  paste(day_input[["flow"]][["road_id"]], day_input[["flow"]][["time"]])
)
measurement_at <- match(
  paste(road_input[["measurements"]][["road_id"]], road_input[["measurements"]][["time"]], road_input[["measurements"]][["metric"]]),
  paste(day_input[["measurements"]][["road_id"]], day_input[["measurements"]][["time"]], day_input[["measurements"]][["metric"]])
)

validation <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Teaching flow records agree with the complete prepared day",
    "Teaching measurements agree with the complete prepared day",
    "Complete flow row count equals roads multiplied by frames",
    "No duplicated road_id-time keys are present",
    "The current lineage contains exactly 720 selected roads",
    "The full day contains 96 unique consecutive fifteen-minute frames",
    "Unknown physical volume units remain explicit",
    "Native coverage and fill metadata are retained",
    "Observed primary values are finite and nonnegative",
    "Source files remain unchanged during report generation"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    !anyNA(flow_at) && identical(road_input[["flow"]][["flow"]], day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]][flow_at]),
    !anyNA(measurement_at) && identical(road_input[["measurements"]][["value"]], day_input[["measurements"]][["value"]][measurement_at]),
    nrow(day_input[["flow"]]) == nrow(day_input[["roads"]]) * length(day_input[["times"]]),
    !anyDuplicated(day_input[["flow"]][c("road_id", "time")]),
    nrow(day_input$roads) == 720,
    length(day_input$times) == 96 && !anyDuplicated(day_input$times) && all(diff(day_input$times) == 900),
    identical(day_input$unit, "source volume"),
    all(c("volume", "speed") %in% names(day_input$provenance$native_coverage)),
    all(is.finite(day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]][!is.na(day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]])]) & day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]][!is.na(day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]])] >= 0),
    identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files))
  )
)
knitr::kable(validation, caption = "Core validation results", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)

coverage <- data.frame(
  Roads = nrow(day_input[["roads"]]),
  Frames = length(day_input[["times"]]),
  `Interval (minutes)` = unique(day_input[["interval_seconds"]]) / 60,
  `Flow records` = nrow(day_input[["flow"]]),
  `Measurement records` = nrow(day_input[["measurements"]]),
  `Trend records` = nrow(day_input[["trends"]]),
  `Missing flow` = sum(is.na(day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]])),
  `Observed zeros` = sum(day_input[["flow"]][["flow"]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  Unit = day_input[["unit"]],
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(coverage, caption = "Complete-data coverage", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)

native_coverage <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("volume", "speed"), function(key) {
  item <- day_input$provenance$native_coverage[[key]]
  status <- as.integer(item$native_status)
  data.frame(
    Source = key,
    `Native missing cells` = sum(status == 0L),
    `Native observed nonzero cells` = sum(status == 1L),
    `Native observed zero cells` = sum(status == 2L),
    `Imputed fifteen-minute frames` = sum(item$frame_imputed),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(native_coverage, caption = "Native coverage retained separately from prepared availability", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

<div class="result">Every validation row must be <code>TRUE</code>. Prepared availability does not erase native missingness: native status, contributor counts, imputation flags, and fill methods remain in provenance and are reported separately.</div>

## Reproduce the report

From the bundle root, render the report without background streets.

```bash
Rscript examples/metropolis/run.R --offline
```

`basemap=FALSE` requires no network. Reading the original Parquets requires Python 3 with NumPy, pandas, and PyArrow; the supplied prepared object can be plotted in R without rerunning Python. With `basemap=TRUE`, verified caches may be reused, while a new background request requires network access.

Common problems include missing Python dependencies, duplicate or gapped timestamps, a road ID absent from the selected register, unknown speed-limit codes, invalid calibration, and reuse of an existing export directory. Physical volume units remain unresolved and must stay labelled `source volume`.

Add `--export` to also write `output/prepared-data/` and `output/figures/` in this example's directory. The `output/figures/map-input.rds` file can be drawn directly.

### Adapt a teaching CSV with renamed columns {.unnumbered}

This separate exercise remaps the columns of a teaching CSV. The report's original data are read from Parquet.

```{r renamed-csv}
lesson_volume <- read.csv("data/lesson/volume.csv", check.names = FALSE)
incoming <- lesson_volume
names(incoming) <- c("source_time", paste0("volume_road_", native$ids))
column_mapping <- setNames(names(incoming), names(lesson_volume))

mapped_volume <- incoming[unname(column_mapping)]
names(mapped_volume) <- names(column_mapping)
stopifnot(identical(mapped_volume, lesson_volume))
head(incoming)
```

The mapping changes headers only. It does not change road IDs, timestamps, missingness, units, aggregation, or the public `traffic_data()` call.

### Export, read back, and reuse {.unnumbered}

The teaching `road_input` object is published to a new temporary directory. The export contains RDS and CSV tables, road vertices, a data dictionary, validation records, source identities, metadata, and checksums.

```{r prepared-export}
prepared_export_dir <- tempfile("metropolis-prepared-export-")
dictionary <- read.csv("data/data-dictionary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dictionary_key <- paste(dictionary$table, dictionary$field, sep = "/")
standard_key <- unlist(lapply(
  c("roads", "flow", "measurements", "trends"),
  function(table) paste(table, names(road_input[[table]]), sep = "/")
))
dictionary <- dictionary[dictionary_key %in% standard_key, ]

declared_sources <- c(
  selection_file,
  calibration_file,
  file.path(raw_directory, paste0(
    "city-traffic-M-raw-",
    c("static-features", "volume", "speed"),
    ".parquet"
  ))
)
prepared_path <- write_traffic_input(
  road_input,
  prepared_export_dir,
  source_files = declared_sources,
  native = native,
  dictionary = dictionary
)
restored <- readRDS(prepared_path)
```

```{r prepared-export-checks, echo=FALSE}
metadata <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(prepared_export_dir, "metadata.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
exported_flow <- read.csv(
  file.path(prepared_export_dir, "flow.csv"),
  na.strings = metadata$csv$missing,
  colClasses = c(road_id = "character")
)
manifest <- read.csv(file.path(prepared_export_dir, "checksums.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
core_fields <- setdiff(names(road_input), "provenance")
export_checks <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "RDS core fields read back unchanged",
    "CSV IDs, times, values, and missingness read back correctly",
    "Dictionary and validation files are present",
    "Prepared-export checksums agree",
    "Source files remain unchanged"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    all(vapply(core_fields, function(key) identical(restored[[key]], road_input[[key]]), logical(1))),
    identical(exported_flow$road_id, road_input$flow$road_id) &&
      identical(as.numeric(exported_flow$time), as.numeric(road_input$flow$time)) &&
      identical(is.na(exported_flow$flow), is.na(road_input$flow$flow)) &&
      isTRUE(all.equal(exported_flow$flow, road_input$flow$flow, check.attributes = FALSE)),
    all(file.exists(file.path(prepared_export_dir, c("data-dictionary.csv", "validation.csv")))),
    identical(
      unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(prepared_export_dir, manifest$file))),
      manifest$md5
    ),
    identical(source_before, tools::md5sum(source_files))
  )
)
knitr::kable(data.frame(file = sort(list.files(prepared_export_dir))), caption = "Prepared-data export files", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(export_checks, caption = "Prepared-data readback checks", format = "html", row.names = FALSE)
```

#### Export figures and selected records {.unnumbered}

The figure export also saves the chosen frame as `map-input.rds` for direct drawing and includes `selected-frame.rds` as a verification snapshot.

```{r figure-export}
export_selected_map <- function(directory) {
  if (file.exists(directory)) stop("The requested export directory already exists.")
  staging <- tempfile("metropolis-figure-export-", tmpdir = dirname(directory))
  export_view <- day_view
  export_view$title <- volume_map$data$title
  export_view$scale <- volume_map$data$scale
  export_view$basemap <- volume_map$data$basemap
  previous_options <- options(bdynets.basemap.auto = FALSE)
  on.exit({
    options(previous_options)
    unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE)
  })
  traffic_export(
    export_view,
    staging,
    index = frame_index,
    input_files = c(prepared = prepared_file)
  )
  manifest_file <- file.path(staging, "checksums.csv")
  manifest <- read.csv(manifest_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  map_path <- file.path(staging, "map-input.rds")
  saveRDS(map_input, map_path, compress = "xz")
  manifest <- rbind(manifest, data.frame(file = basename(map_path),
    bytes = file.info(map_path)$size, md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(map_path))))
  manifest <- manifest[order(manifest$file), , drop = FALSE]
  write.csv(manifest, manifest_file, row.names = FALSE)
  if (!file.rename(staging, directory)) stop("Cannot publish the figure export.")
}

figure_export_dir <- tempfile("metropolis-figure-export-")
export_selected_map(figure_export_dir)
```

  Passed = c(

if (params$export) {
  if (file.exists(params$export_dir)) stop("The requested export directory already exists; choose a new directory.")
  dir.create(params$export_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  write_traffic_input(
    road_input,
    file.path(params$export_dir, "prepared-data"),
    source_files = declared_sources,
    native = native,
    dictionary = dictionary
  )
  export_selected_map(file.path(params$export_dir, "figures"))
}

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    file = conversion_files,

bundle_dir <- file.path("..", "..", "bdynets")
bundle_files <- list.files(bundle_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = FALSE)
bundle_sha <- vapply(file.path(bundle_dir, bundle_files), digest::digest, "", file = TRUE, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)
revision <- digest::digest(paste(paste(bundle_files, bundle_sha, sep = " "), collapse = "\n"), algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)

cat("Package version:", as.character(packageVersion("bdynets")), "\n")
cat("Bundled source revision (SHA-256):", revision, "\n")
python_versions <- system2(

  stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE
)
cat(python_versions, sep = "\n")
